Transferred CC @Faless

```suggestion
// clang-format off
#define SET_DOCUMENT_METHOD(method) set_method("textDocument/method", callable_mp(text_document.ptr(), &GDScriptTextDocument::method))
#define SET_COMPLETION_METHOD(method) set_method("completionItem/method", callable_mp(text_document.ptr(), &GDScriptTextDocument::method))
#define SET_WORKSPACE_METHOD(method) set_method("workspace/method", callable_mp(workspace.ptr(), &GDScriptWorkspace::method))
```

I would also use `m_method` for the parameter, as the `m_` prefix is a convention we usually use for macro parameters.

And with the direct string usage, you don't need to disable clang-format anymore.

Yeah the entry is still needed here as the API *is* removed from the main API scope, but it's exposed back as a compatibility method only. So it's only accessible from GDExtension, GDScript would still break if trying to access it (and it doesn't show up in the docs).

I think this is fine like this, but the alternative approach would be to expose it back as a normal method (enclosed in `#ifndef DISABLE_DEPRECATED`), which would bring it back in the public API/docs, where it should also be flagged as deprecated.
